title: The Final Archive Revisited
author: Wren Ravensworth
blurb: Zephyrine Ishikawa, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
